editorial_criteria.requirement: Card 3 communicates the next meaningful quality or a precise evidence-based reason it is withheld
No unverified booking date or execution authority is attached to conditional quality
Fueling quantities include unit, workout context, and timing where applicable, without contradictory figures
Remove repetitions and generic disclaimers that do not change athlete action or safety; retain safety-critical caveats
One glance should reveal prescribed action, duration/steps/watts, why, and any important condition

typography_criteria.requirement: Consistent display/body families and clear hierarchy between page/card/metric/microcopy
No clipped glyphs, overflow, unreadable contrast, or broken text wrapping
Compare weights, line-height and contrast to owner-approved screenshot baseline

caution: Numeric text-length and font-size thresholds are REVIEW signals, never automatic editorial/esthetic acceptance. Keep private-report screenshots out of public artifacts.
